claim_state: E2 self-reported: one host, one card, not independently reproduced

hardware.gpu: 1x Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GB (headless card)
hardware.power_cap_note: as-found cap, not changed for the run
hardware.server_resident_vram_source: DRM fdinfo at the recipe flags (-ub 4096)
hardware.offload: none; the whole model is on the card

engine.name: llama.cpp
engine.build: native GGML_SYCL_F16=ON build of the same commit and engine changes (the published patch adds only an OUT_PROD test case)
engine.measured_build_note: llama_bench_c1, server_c1 and the catalog record come from this native build
engine.unpatched_control: stock 620d2225c, GGML_SYCL_F16 off; ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server-intel-b11669 was not measured

model.quantization: IQ2_XXS routed/shared experts, NVFP4 Mamba projections, Q8_0 rest
model.architecture: 88 layers: 40 Mamba-2, 40 latent MoE (<=496 experts per layer, top-9), 8 GQA attention (32q/2kv); about 9B active

llama_bench_c1.method: llama-bench, C1, built-in same-shape warmup, 5 reps, median; synthetic tokens, cold prefix; stock and patched builds in separate sequential sessions

server_c1.method: llama-server timings, greedy, thinking off, cold prompt, recipe flags

image_check.label: image check: pinned image, same card, same recipe flags, docker run; llama-server timings, greedy, thinking off
image_check.smoke: 6 cases pass; greedy text byte-identical to the native build
image_check.finding: the image decodes about 6% slower than the native build; cause not isolated (bundled runtime or GGML_BACKEND_DL build)

context_check.label: context capacity: -c 262144 (the GGUF's trained maximum), recipe flags otherwise unchanged; llama-server timings, greedy, thinking off, cold prompt, one needle sentence at 50% depth

resident_vram_gib.source: DRM fdinfo drm-total-vram0 of the llama-server process; card has 32 GB

context_check.scope: one needle per prompt, one request at a time; not a long-context quality benchmark

drafter.result: runs after the patch, greedy output identical, 87% accepted, decode 25.7 vs 28.1 tok/s without it
drafter.reason: a 7-token verify costs about 5x one decode step on SYCL

quality.smoke: 6 greedy cases (arithmetic, capital, letter count, code, translation, image) pass; text byte-identical to the stock build

kld_vs_stock_f32_path.cause: f16 activation rounding, same as upstream GGML_SYCL_F16=ON images

quality.scope: a 6-case smoke does not establish general quality

thinking: on by default (chat template); chat_template_kwargs {"enable_thinking": false} turns it off
untested: llama-bench on the image, and image server runs beyond the two image_check prompts
task-quality benchmarks beyond the 6-case smoke and the KLD screen
